title: Inside the Box
setup: White has just pushed the h-pawn to the fifth, and its own king is stranded in the far corner.
hint: Sketch the box h5–h8–e8–e5 and ask which of your king moves actually lands inside it.
explanation:
## The Idea

A pawn on h5 needs three moves to queen, so any king that can reach the box h5–h8–e8–e5 catches it. From d4 only {{Ke5}} steps inside: {{h6}} {{Kf6}} and the king shadows the pawn all the way to h8. Every other move is one tempo short.
